data.title: Rapid Certificate Issuance on Crisis-Themed Domain — Sub-48h Registration-to-Cert Velocity
data.description: Detects TLS certificate issuance within 48 hours of domain registration on crisis-themed domains. Legitimate organizations typically register domains days to weeks before certificate provisioning, while crisis-exploitation infrastructure shows a characteristic sub-48h registration-to-cert velocity as threat actors race to deploy HTTPS-credible phishing pages before awareness develops. Certificate transparency logs provide the data source. CrimsonVector documented this rapid-cert pattern across 1,435 crisis-themed domains during the 2026 oil shock, with Let's Encrypt and ZeroSSL as the primary issuers.
references: CrimsonVector, 2026 Iran War Oil Shock Domain Intelligence Report — rapid cert issuance pattern
Certificate Transparency (RFC 6962) — Public CT log monitoring
falsepositives: Legitimate rapid-deployment sites using automated certificate provisioning
CDN-provisioned certificates on legitimate customer domains
